UNDERSTAND THE PRODUCT

Product description

Single-year qualityMulti-year quality

Also known as: Lucerne
Botanical name: Medicago sativa L.

Alfalfa seeds are offered for planting enquiries to establish a fodder crop. Buyers should specify the variety, intended growing region and seed-quality requirements. Planting seed quality must be described using a lot-specific test report and any required certification.

This listing concerns planting seed. It does not describe seed for human consumption or sprouting. Required variety, certification and export eligibility must be confirmed for the destination.

Common applications

Fodder crop establishment; agricultural seed distribution.

Specification status

Listed quality options are confirmed by Shiva Exim. Detailed limits, packing and lot test results are confirmed in the final offer.

PLANTING ENQUIRIES

How much seed is needed for sowing?

Reference quantities for the stated growing system. Confirm a local recommendation before ordering planting seed.

Sowing quantity — reference guidance
DetailGuidance
Reference seed quantity20 kg/hectare (approximately 8.1 kg/acre)
Sowing systemLucerne grown for fodder; the cited Tamil Nadu Agricultural University guide describes line sowing at 25 cm row spacing.
How to apply this referenceAn Indian extension reference for establishing a fodder stand. Confirm the rate for your variety, growing region, sowing method and seed treatment or coating. Single-year and multi-year commercial labels do not establish separate sowing rates.

Request a current, lot-specific germination and physical-purity report, the test date, variety identity and treatment or coating status. For alfalfa, also confirm the reported hard-seed percentage. Physical purity alone does not establish planting suitability. Seed rate is a cultivation guideline, not a minimum order quantity or a yield guarantee.

Agronomic reference: TNAU — Lucerne fodder crop production ↗. Checked 22 October 2026. Acre figures are rounded conversions using 1 hectare ≈ 2.471 acres. These Indian reference rates are not destination-specific recommendations.

PRACTICAL BUYING DETAILS

Before you choose a lot.

Match the product, specification and commercial terms.

Product questions

What do single-year and multi-year quality mean here?

These are the commercial quality labels confirmed by Shiva Exim. They are not a guarantee of stand life, yield or a named variety. Confirm the actual variety, growing region and lot-quality requirements separately.

What should the seed report identify?

Request the actual lot number, laboratory, test date, physical purity, normal germination, hard seed, other seeds and moisture requirements. Confirm treatment, coating and certification needs with the specific offer.

What is the minimum order quantity?

Our listed minimum order is 1 metric tonne. Confirm your grade, packing and destination with the quotation.

Can I request a sample and lot report?

Samples are available without a product charge; shipping costs apply. State the sample quantity and required tests. Lot reports and dispatch arrangements are confirmed for the proposed offer.

Which loading port and shipment lead time apply?

Indian loading ports can be arranged with the quotation. Usual preparation is 10–15 days after order confirmation; final dispatch depends on the agreed specification, documents and freight arrangements.

Which payment terms are available?

T/T, L/C and PayPal are listed payment options. The payment schedule, currency and method must be agreed in the quotation before an order is confirmed.
